title_en: Funny Stories from Life (3/20): Two Weeks in the Wrong Group Chat
note_en: 直到……才…… means "not until... did...": 直到他在群里看到“三年二班”的通知，才突然反应过来 "It wasn't until he saw a notice for Grade 3, Class 2 that it suddenly hit him." English puts the negative on the first part ("not until"), while Chinese stays positive and marks the late realization with 才 before the second verb.

sentences.en: The more Xiao Jie thought about it, the more curious he became. He worked up the courage to post a message in the Class 2 group, asking whether everyone had known all along that he'd joined the wrong group. The class monitor replied, "Sure we knew. But since you never said a word, we figured some other class had sent you in as a 'spy.'"
